### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A27, A36, A37, A42 and A43 appear in every trace (100%) instead of about half (47–54%) before; their mean occurrences per trace rise from about 0.5 to about 1.0. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC005, OCC006]
- A40 also increases from about 45% to 58% of traces, but not to 100%. [OCC004]
- The successor of A25 changes: before, about 95% of its outgoing transitions went to A28; after, about 29% go to A43, 25% to A37, 25% to A42 and 19% to A36, with none to A28. [DIR001]
- A26's successor becomes almost exclusively A27 (about 97% after vs 47% before), with the former shares to A36/A37/A42/A43 disappearing. [DIR002]
- For A36, A37, A42 and A43, the successor A31 (about 21–29% before) disappears, replaced by A28 (about 20–29% after). [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- Positions shift: A36, A37, A42 and A43 move from around 0.58 of the trace to around 0.40; A28 moves from 0.39 to 0.47; A26 from 0.54 to 0.61; A27 from 0.59 to 0.64. [POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS004, POS002, POS003]
- Before, A27 and A36/A37/A42/A43 were mutually exclusive (co-occurrence about 1.5%); after they co-occur in 100% of traces, with A36/A37/A42/A43 before A27 in about 96–99% of traces. [REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- Before, A25 and A26 preceded A36/A37/A42/A43 in about 53% of traces; after, A25 still precedes them (about 95–98%), but A26 now follows them (about 97–99% have A36/A37/A42/A43 before A26). [REL002, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010]
- A28 before A27: before 46.5%, after 98.5%. [REL011]
- A25 to A28 lag: before lag 1 in 96.5%, after lag 5 in 99.4%. [LAG001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process changed from a choice between two alternative paths — one containing A27 and one containing A36/A37/A42/A43 — to a single path that includes both, with the A36/A37/A42/A43 activities occurring earlier in the trace, before A28/A26/A27, and A25 still early. The supporting signs are consistent across participation, successor, position and relational indicators: A27 and the A36/A37/A42/A43 group all become mandatory, their co-occurrence jumps from about 1.5% to 100%, A26 flips from preceding to following that group, A25's successor changes from A28 to the group, and A28 becomes a successor of the group. A competing explanation of sampling differences in variant frequencies is unlikely given the consistency across many indicators, but the exact order among A36/A37/A42/A43 is not fully determined, and some lag items have very low support in one window.
